mechanics.title: Proximity voice
mechanics.description: Voice volume falls off with distance and is positional (3D). Whispering uses a shorter range.

mechanics.title: Groups
mechanics.description: Players can create groups with an optional password. Group types: Normal (non-members cannot hear the group, but members hear everyone), Open (everyone hears everyone) and Isolated (members and non-members cannot hear each other).

mechanics.title: Input and processing
mechanics.description: Push-to-talk or voice activation, automatic gain, RNNoise noise suppression, microphone/speaker test, per-player volume sliders, and optional audio recording.

mechanics.title: Icons
mechanics.description: HUD and name-tag icons show who is talking or whispering, muted microphone, disabled voice chat, and connection problems.

qol: First-run onboarding guide helps set the push-to-talk key and test the microphone.
commands_and_keybinds: V: open the voice chat menu (settings, groups, mute, disable, hide icons, recording)
Push-to-talk, whisper and mute keys are rebindable in Controls
getting_started: On first launch, follow the setup guide to pick a microphone and push-to-talk key. If you cannot connect, the server host must open the voice chat UDP port (see the mod wiki).
editor_notes: Default UDP port (24454, from general knowledge) is not in the extracted facts; verify against server config. Works in single player/LAN only if run_local_server is enabled.
name: Simple Voice Chat
summary: Proximity voice chat for multiplayer. Players hear each other based on distance with 3D sound, and can use push-to-talk or voice activation, whisper, join groups, and adjust other players' volume. Players need the mod installed, and the server needs it plus an open UDP port for voice traffic.
